work_item: B03 exact normalization of explicitly supplied probability weights
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This continuation recorded implementation and compile/lint/build evidence only; no test or runtime route observation was made.

supported_behavior_from_source: The finite declarative parser accepts one explicit flat array through Japanese 「確率分布 [..] を正規化して」 / 「を正規化してください」 and English `normalize-probabilities [..]` forms.
Between 1 and 4096 exact scalar weights are accepted; negative values and an all-zero total produce typed suspension errors.
Each output probability is the exact rational quotient of its supplied weight by the exact total; an internal invariant checks that the exact output sum is one.
The JSON report preserves input weights, total, normalized probabilities, count and probability sum, and labels the scope as supplied weights rather than empirical or real-world likelihood.
The parser rejects trailing constraints for this operation; arithmetic representation and operation budgets remain bounded.
